editorial_notes.recommended_hook: GOAT Papers: Chinchilla: Compute-Optimal Large Language Models Mini-Series 2/5: Chinchilla: Compute-Optimal Large Language Models: Part 2 - IsoFLOP Contour Hyperbolas: The 1:1 Mathematical Balance of Parameters and Tokens
